# Vietnam Thermal Power Plant Reference Inventory (>30 MWe)

> **Methodology note:** This inventory is compiled from parametric knowledge of Vietnamese government documents (Power Development Plans, EVN/PVN/Vinacomin reports), IEA, GEM (Global Energy Monitor), and major project announcements available up to my knowledge cut-off (early 2025). Because I cannot browse the internet, **URLs are cited as known canonical addresses**; readers should verify current availability. Where two independent sources confirm a data point, both are listed. Where data is uncertain, a note flags the uncertainty.

---

## Caveats & Limitations

1. Vietnam's **Power Development Plan 8 (PDP8)**, approved by Prime Minister Decision No. 500/QĐ-TTg on 15 May 2023, is the primary planning document for 2021–2030 with a vision to 2050. It supersedes PDP7 Revised (Decision 428/QĐ-TTg, 2016).
2. Unit sizes and CODs for projects under construction or planned frequently change; figures reflect the most recently confirmed data.
3. "Domestic gas" refers to gas from Vietnamese offshore fields (Nam Con Son, PM3-CAA, Block B, etc.). "Imported LNG" refers to regasified LNG at purpose-built terminals.
4. Plants below 30 MWe (e.g., small diesel/HFO peakers) are excluded.
5. Several PDP8 LNG projects have **not yet reached financial close** and carry high schedule risk.

---

| PVN / PetroVietnam | Vietnam Oil and Gas Group |
